AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Adding Value to Crop Produce 8 4.4 Making Homemade Soap 8 Total Number of Lesson and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Adding Value to Crop Produce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
